summary: Iteration 25 backend hardening validated end-to-end: 17/17 tests pass against the preview backend (https://gift-hub-sync.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified public pricing (SKUs + plans object with monthly/yearly/lifetime features+cta+billing_period), auth guards on /quota /subscription/status /rewarded/claim (all 401 without X-User-Id or Bearer), server-side premium resolution (X-Is-Premium header ignored — is_premium stays false), /subscription/verify success + cross-user purchase_token replay blocked with 403 purchase_token_bound_to_other_user (unique index working), unknown_product and purchase_token_required 400s, /subscription/status flips is_premium true→false after RTDN CANCELED (notificationType=3) event, RTDN test pings (empty body + empty JSON) return 200 ok without crash, and AI /ai/vocabulary/lookup does not accept X-Is-Premium hint (quota endpoint still reports is_premium=false).
critical_code_review_comments: system_routes.py is 628 lines — approaching the 700-line file-split threshold; consider extracting RTDN webhook + handlers into a rtdn_routes.py module.

auth_deps.SECURE_BILLING is evaluated at import time only. If an ops user sets SECURE_BILLING=true at runtime and reload isn't triggered, trust-mode remains. Consider evaluating per-request or documenting the restart requirement.

TestAIPremiumHeaderIgnored is a weak assertion — it only checks non-5xx. A stronger test would exhaust free quota then confirm the endpoint 429s even with X-Is-Premium: true. Out of scope for a single-endpoint smoke test but worth adding as an integration test later.

Legacy test_subscription_verify_hardening.py::test_rewarded_claim_premium still asserts X-Is-Premium: true → premium_no_bonus_needed. This is now stale (server ignores header) — should be removed or flipped to assert bonus IS granted. Not blocking iter25 but will fail on next full-suite run.
test_credentials: none required — synthetic UIDs (userA_*, userB_*, fresh_user_*, hax_user_*) used
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 synthetic subscription docs in db.subscriptions (uid userA_*/userB_* variants) and rtdn_events entries. Cleanup optional per request note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter25 billing security hardening endpoints are working. If retesting later, note that test_subscription_verify_hardening.py::test_rewarded_claim_premium is stale (expects deprecated X-Is-Premium trust behavior) and will fail — that assertion should be updated to expect a granted bonus since server no longer trusts the client header.
